description: Get the buying committee DealMap for a prospect company. DealMaps are held at corporate-family grain: a subsidiary ticker resolves upward to the family's DealMap and the response names the family. Shows stakeholders with AI-assigned roles (Economic Buyer, Decision Maker, Champion, Executive Sponsor, Evaluator, Blocker, etc.), org hierarchy edges, and a buying_committee_summary identifying the top pick for each role. Each stakeholder carries placement: "placed" (in the reporting hierarchy) or "unplaced" (listed at the company but not placed in the hierarchy; reporting line unknown, no edges implied — added when the placed chart is sparse). Use this to understand who is involved in the purchase decision. When the workspace has email reveal, each stakeholder also has email_status (unlocked, team_supplied, locked, do_not_contact or unavailable) and email_credits; work_email is null while locked, and get_dealmap_emails reveals it for 1 credit only when an address is delivered. Free operation. Returns status "empty" if no DealMap has been generated yet — call generate_dealmap first. When the response has freshness (newer_people_data: true), DealSurface holds newer people data than this saved map was built from: the map is still usable; tell the user, and refresh only if they want it (generate_dealmap with force_refresh=true costs freshness.refresh_credits and needs the outreach scope). When stakeholder_role_source is "generated", the stakeholder's annotation_score (0.0-1.0) is DealSurface's confidence in that role assignment, and annotation_reason explains it. Describe it as high, medium or low confidence, never as a raw number like 0.48. When stakeholder_role_source is "manual", the user's team chose the role: say so, and don't attribute annotation_score or annotation_reason to it (they describe the earlier AI-assigned role). When a role's generated top pick has low confidence, say so and name the other stakeholders with the same stakeholder_role as alternatives, without replacing DealSurface's top pick.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (subsidiary tickers resolve to the corporate family)

name: get_dealmap
